---
title: "Benchmarks"
---

```{r setup, include = FALSE}
source("setup.R")
results <- file.path("..", "..", "..", "site", "data", "benchmarks.csv")
meta_file <- file.path("..", "..", "..", "site", "data", "benchmarks.json")
have <- file.exists(results)
if (have) {
  b <- read.csv(results, stringsAsFactors = FALSE)
  ok <- b[b$status == "ok", ]
  meta <- if (requireNamespace("jsonlite", quietly = TRUE)) {
    jsonlite::fromJSON(meta_file)$meta
  }
}
label <- c("peabiru-cli" = "peabiru CLI", "peabiru-r" = "peabiru (R)",
           "peabiru-py" = "peabiru (Python)", "r5r" = "r5r", "r5py" = "r5py")
task <- c(build = "network build", ttm_walk = "matrix, walk",
          ttm_bicycle = "matrix, bicycle", ttm_car = "matrix, car",
          ttm_transit = "matrix, walk + transit",
          accessibility = "accessibility, walk + transit",
          expanded = "expanded, walk + transit (50 origins)")
num <- function(x, d = 2) formatC(x, format = "f", digits = d, big.mark = ",")
```

How long peabiru takes, and how much memory it uses, against r5r and r5py on
the same tasks, inputs and parameters. Every number on this page is read from
`site/data/benchmarks.csv` in the repository, written by
`bench/site/run.py`; the methodology is on the
[benchmarks page of the main site](../../benchmarks.html).

**These numbers are provisional**: they were measured while the engine was
still being optimised, on a machine that was also busy with other work.

```{r, echo = FALSE, results = "asis", eval = !have}
cat("No results file yet: run `bench/site/run.py` at the root of the repository.\n")
```

```{r, echo = FALSE, results = "asis", eval = have}
if (!is.null(meta)) {
  m <- meta$machine
  cat(sprintf(
    "Measured on %s, %s (%s cores, %s GiB RAM), load average %s when the run started; peabiru commit `%s`.\n\n",
    substr(meta$generated, 1, 10), m$cpu, m$cores, m$ram_gib,
    m$load_avg_at_start[1], meta$versions$peabiru_commit))
  eng <- meta$engines
  for (e in names(eng)) {
    s <- eng[[e]]
    cat(sprintf("- **%s**: %s\n", label[[e]],
                if (identical(s$status, "ok")) s$version else paste("not run:", s$reason)))
  }
}
```

## Walk + public transport, Porto Alegre

```{r, echo = FALSE, results = "asis", eval = have}
row <- function(e, t, c = "poa", n = max(ok$threads)) {
  ok[ok$engine == e & ok$task == t & ok$city == c & ok$threads == n, ]
}
p <- row("peabiru-r", "ttm_transit")
r <- row("r5r", "ttm_transit")
if (nrow(p) == 1 && nrow(r) == 1) {
  cat(sprintf(
    "With %d threads, the travel-time matrix took %s s with peabiru and %s s with r5r (%s times faster), with a peak memory of %s MiB against %s MiB.\n",
    max(ok$threads), num(p$seconds), num(r$seconds), num(r$seconds / p$seconds, 1),
    num(p$peak_rss_mib, 0), num(r$peak_rss_mib, 0)))
}
```

## All tasks

```{r, echo = FALSE, results = "asis", eval = have}
charts <- list.files(file.path("..", "..", "..", "site", "assets", "charts"),
                     pattern = "^bench-.*\\.svg$")
charts <- charts[order(!grepl("-t10\\.svg$", charts), charts)]
for (f in charts) {
  cat(sprintf("![%s](%s)\n\n", sub("\\.svg$", "", f), fig_path(f)))
}
```

```{r, echo = FALSE, eval = have}
tab <- ok[ok$task != "", c("city", "threads", "task", "engine", "seconds", "peak_rss_mib")]
tab$task <- factor(task[tab$task], levels = task)
tab$engine <- label[tab$engine]
tab <- tab[order(tab$city, -tab$threads, tab$task, tab$engine), ]
names(tab) <- c("city", "threads", "task", "engine", "median seconds", "peak MiB")
knitr::kable(tab, row.names = FALSE)
```

## Reproducing

```sh
# from the repository root; r5r needs a JDK 21
python3 bench/site/run.py          # writes site/data/benchmarks.{json,csv}
python3 bench/site/charts.py       # charts and the tables of the web pages
```
